profile_notes: Default safe profile for Windows users with RTX 4070 8GB: generate at 1280x720, batch size 1, use VRAM safety, and offload long or high-resolution jobs to RunPod when needed.

sdxl_checkpoint.notes: Place a compatible SDXL checkpoint in ComfyUI/models/checkpoints.

wan_video_model.notes: Recommended for higher-quality video workflows; use RunPod if local VRAM is insufficient.

vae.notes: Place compatible VAE files in ComfyUI/models/vae when required by a workflow.

loras.notes: Partner and general-physics LoRAs should be linked or copied to ComfyUI/models/loras.

runpod.notes: RunPod is optional but recommended for long Wan jobs, high-resolution upscales, or repeated CUDA out-of-memory errors on 8GB GPUs.
